svg.text: Objective: minimise blade volume V = ∫ A(r) dr, subject to bending stress σ ≤ 20 MPa at every node (yield 30 MPa / safety factor 1.5)
A Cross-section at one spanwise node
skin + box hybrid shown; thicknesses drawn larger than scale, vertical scale ×3
chord c = 150 mm, NACA 0012 (fixed by the brief)
B Along the span: a section is chosen at each of the 100 nodes
recommended hybrid; chordwise direction drawn vertically
100 nodes: t_skin, w, t_wall chosen at every node
bending moment M(r) falls → each section may only stay the same or shrink toward the tip (printable)
box width 98 → 10 mm, wall 2.0 → 0.8 mm; total V = 473 cm³
• stepped skin: where each 0.4 mm step ends
exact: each step starts where stress allows
linear tapers root → tip, fmincon, 20 starts
• hollow box: x_s, w_root, w_tip, t_root, t_tip
plus x_s swept 0.24 – 0.44 (same at all nodes)
• σ_i = |M_i| y_max / I_i ≤ 20 MPa at every node
• walls in whole 0.4 mm perimeters, ≥ 0.8 mm
• sections only stay the same or shrink root → tip
